Loss-of-function variants in ALDH7A1 disrupt both pyridoxal phosphate metabolism and glutamate metabolism. partners.mechanism_chain: ALDH7A1 (HGNC:496) —DISRUPTS→ alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde (CHEBI:23987); alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde (CHEBI:23987) —DECREASES→ pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (PLP) (CHEBI:17917); pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (PLP) (CHEBI:17917) —DECREASES→ gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) (CHEBI:15742); gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) (CHEBI:15742) —DECREASES→ Epilepsy (HP:0001250); DMGDH (HGNC:2793) —DISRUPTS→ N,N-dimethylglycine (CHEBI:16793); DMGDH (HGNC:2793) —DISRUPTS→ Sarcosine (CHEBI:17774); N,N-dimethylglycine (CHEBI:16793) —LEADS_TO→ Folate metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1644477); Sarcosine (CHEBI:17774) —LEADS_TO→ Folate metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1644477); Folate metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1644477) —DISRUPTS→ Developmental delay (HP:0001263). partners.mechanism_chain: ALDH7A1 (HGNC:477) —DISRUPTS→ alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde (CHEBI:17604); alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde (CHEBI:17604) —DECREASES→ pyridoxine metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-197320); pyridoxine metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-197320) —LEADS_TO→ seizures (HP:0001250); GCDH (HGNC:4072) —DISRUPTS→ glutaryl-CoA (CHEBI:16881); glutaryl-CoA (CHEBI:16881) —DECREASES→ lysine degradation (REACT:R-HSA-70314); lysine degradation (REACT:R-HSA-70314) —LEADS_TO→ intellectual disability (HP:0001249); lysine degradation (REACT:R-HSA-70314) —LEADS_TO→ neurodevelopmental abnormality (HP:0012422).
